commentary.title: Headnote
commentary.preview: The headnote is a summary of 1 Nephi and is part of the original text. The brief summaries at the head of each chapter are later additions for the reader’s convenience.

commentary.title: Many Afflictions, Yet Highly Favored
commentary.preview: Nephi wrote of “many afflictions” yet also acknowledged many blessings from the Lord. His record recounts numerous trials he and others of his family endured while staying faithful and grateful to the Lord.

commentary.preview: Nephi schrieb von „vielen Bedrängnissen“, bestätigte aber auch, dass der Herr ihn sehr gesegnet hatte. Sein Bericht schildert zahllose Prüfungen, die er und andere Mitglieder seiner Familie ertrugen, während sie dem Herrn treu blieben und ihm dankbar waren. commentary.preview: Nephi skrev om ”många lidanden” men erkände också att han fått många välsignelser av Herren. Han redogör för en mängd prövningar som han och andra i hans familj utstod medan de förblev trofasta och tacksamma mot Herren. commentary.title: «Высокое благоволение», несмотря на «многие страдания»
commentary.preview: В его летописи упоминаются многочисленные испытания, которые перенесли он и его близкие, оставаясь верными и благодарными Господу. Напротив, мы также видим, что Ламану и Лемуилу, равно как и многим другим людям из Книги Мормона, частые страдания нужны были для того, чтобы напоминать им о благословениях Господа.

commentary.preview: These are truths known only by divine revelation. The doctrines of the incarnation, the birth, the death, the resurrection of Christ and, we may add, the salvation for the dead, are mysteries.

commentary.title: “Many Afflictions… Highly Favored of the Lord”
commentary.preview: Life was not intended to be easy. The path of righteousness, that course leading to eternal life, is ever an upward climb and hence uninviting to many. Nephi saw afflictions and blessings as compatible companions. Surely anything that brings us nearer to God is a blessing.

commentary.title: “Mysteries of God”
commentary.preview: The mysteries of God are known only to those who have so lived as to enjoy the companionship of the Holy Ghost. Because of his faithfulness in the face of affliction, Nephi became a rightful heir to these hidden treasures of God.

commentary.title: “A Record of My Proceedings”
